commands.command: Manual qwen running-tier benchmark + model-target benchmark failure + simulated missing vllm-mlx auto-install check

assertionResults.reason: When model-target benchmark failed, no bench-temp process or stale PID file remained; only manually started tier process was present.
After temporarily removing `vllm-mlx` binary from PATH location, bench auto-installed pinned v0.2.6 and proceeded to target resolution.
Tool-calling benchmark ran for tool-capable qwen3-8b but reported `No tool calls in response` instead of validating a proper tool call structure.
Temp-instance benchmark path failed before successful startup/visible bind details, preventing direct user-surface verification of chosen non-conflicting temporary port.

blockers.description: Temp-instance startup path aborts early, limiting observability of bound temporary port in CLI output for BENCH-009.
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Inspected bench-temp logs and process list; startup failed before healthy service lifecycle could be observed.
